All project rules are defined in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` for architecture, coding standards, component
patterns, banned patterns, and the Angular 18 → 21 migration playbook.

For detailed reference:
- `docs/PROJECT.md`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/CONVENTIONS.md`
- `docs/TESTING.md`
- `docs/MIGRATION_18_TO_21.md`

Scoped rules for components and services live under `.github/instructions/`.
